CustomField.label: Criticality
CustomField.description: The business impact if this integration were to break, expressed as High, Medium, or Low. High criticality means the integration has revenue or regulatory compliance impact and any change touching it should be treated with extra caution and coordinated with the business and technical owners before proceeding. Low criticality means the integration is nice-to-have and a short outage would not meaningfully harm the business.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Business impact if this integration breaks. High = revenue or compliance impact.
